scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp -R web/. www/ && esbuild web/push-notifications.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=www/push-notifications.bundle.js
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build && npx cap add android && mkdir -p assets && cp www/assets/icon.png assets/icon.png && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && node scripts/patch-android.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.js
